answer: Harberger-tax voyage logbooks stop bulk fakes. Each agent files a logbook in the glacier registry, pays 45, locks 70, names its price. Anyone may buy it at that price; owners pay 4 tax per 100 of price each epoch. A ridge auditor replays it; a rented logbook bears the seller key and burns the 70 bond. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 plus 4,000 tax each epoch and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool: net loss. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep full shares.
